dishes.name: steak / steak Pierre in older menus

praise: Lake Union / Cascade views and the midcentury room are the most repeated reason people book
Service is widely described as polished, formal, and the strongest part of the night
Several diners prefer the lounge path (Irish coffee, a smaller spend) over the dining-room tasting
complaints: Food quality called average or inconsistent at a destination ticket — especially versus SF/NYC peers
Portions read as too small once the 20% service charge is in the total
A vocal minority would not return; others treat it as a view-and-service night rather than a cooking night
rep.consistency: Strong agreement on room and service; split on whether the cooking matches the price.
rep.value: Small plates at a high ticket is the dominant value complaint.
rep.service: Attentive, formal, often cited as justifying the included gratuity — not the usual complaint.

praise: Global street-food small plates that actually land — reviewers keep naming Sichuan wing towers, tocino, and brunch shareables
Capitol Hill group night: variety without a tasting lock-in
complaints: A huge map of cuisines means some tables hit a dud dish next to a great one
The room reads as a busy neighborhood spot, not a quiet date
rep.consistency: Identity (global street food, shareable) is stable. Execution is plate-by-plate, not a single house dish.

praise: Cabaret / aerialists and the Pike Place terrace are the identity of the night, not a side show
Italian-American pastas (lasagna, squid-ink, pappardelle) are the dishes people name
Warm, theatrical service matches the room
complaints: Reservations open 30 days out and vanish; late lunch leftovers are what remains if you wait
Walk-in waits of an hour are common on Friday; a texted table is held only briefly
Food can read as good-not-great once the wait and Pike Place logistics are in the total
rep.consistency: Strong agreement that the night is entertainment-plus-pasta; split on whether the cooking alone is the reason to go.
rep.service: Busy but generally well-regarded; the bottleneck is getting a table, not inattentive service.

praise: Short-rib dumplings are the dish people name, often as the reason to return
Korean-fusion plates at a Fremont counter/open kitchen, not a tasting lock
complaints: Louder and more harried when the room fills — dumplings can lag
A service surcharge shows up in recent notes; confirm the live check math
rep.consistency: Dumplings are the stable praise. Noise and pace are the stable tradeoff.
rep.service: Fine when the room is moderate; reviews call it harried at peak.

dishes.name: oysters grown and harvested by Hama Hama
raw oysters grown on the farm

praise: Tide-to-table oysters on Hood Canal — raw and grilled — are the reason for the drive
The A-frame outdoor room and the farm view are part of the night, not a backdrop
complaints: It is outdoors with heaters, not an indoor dining room — dress for rain and wind
Summer waits over an hour are published on the restaurant's own page; the drive from Seattle is real
rep.consistency: Oysters and the outdoor farm are the stable praise. Weather and wait are first-party planning facts.

praise: Oysters — raw and fried — are the dish people name, with servers walking newbies through brine vs sweet
Bartenders and the Ballard bar energy are a repeated plus
Seasonal small plates around the oyster program
complaints: No reservations; waits are the planning fact, especially for four or more
Line forms before open; groups are told to put a name down and wander
A packed, small room — not a quiet date if you arrive at peak
rep.consistency: Agreement on oysters; agreement on the wait. Little debate about what the night is.

praise: Korean steakhouse plates — short rib / kalbi and mackerel — are the dishes people name
Service is often called the equal of the cooking on a special-occasion night
complaints: Portions read small once you are paying steakhouse money; sharing entrees is a common warning
A surprise surcharge (reviewers have flagged 4%) shows up on the check
rep.consistency: Cooking identity is stable. Value and surcharge are the recurring friction.
rep.value: Small-plate steakhouse: order more than you think, and read the check for added fees.

praise: Seasonal Northwest cooking (salmon, foraged mushrooms, generous tasting) and unhurried service
The four-course path is described as substantial, not precious tweezer food
complaints: A recurring minority call the cooking underwhelming at the ticket — beautiful, not memorable
Corkage and the overall spend are called out as planning facts, not surprises only at the end
rep.consistency: Room and service are the safer praise. Cooking-to-price is mixed.

praise: Northern Italian tasting (risotto, scallops, pasta, a vegetarian/vegan path) with recovery-level service
Kirkland destination for a milestone night, not a Seattle walk-in
complaints: The live total (tasting + wine + service fee) is the shock: diners report $600–$1000 for two
Small tasting portions at that ticket are noted even by people who loved the risotto
rep.consistency: Cooking and service are the praise. The all-in number is the planning fact.
rep.value: Prix-fixe tasting: confirm the live ticket, wine, and service fee before you treat $205 as the night.

dishes.name: themed tasting (changes; do not treat a past menu as live)

praise: Garden, themed tasting, and long-form service are the reason people book Woodinville
Staff knowledge of the farm and pairing is the repeated service praise
complaints: Price and length of the night versus portion size is the recurring value complaint
A destination ticket — not a flexible à-la-carte out if someone at the table wants an exit
rep.consistency: Praise clusters on garden and service; complaints cluster on ticket and duration.
rep.value: High ticket, prix-fixe only; value complaints are about length and price, not about being cheated on a listed steak.
rep.service: Formal, explanatory, generally the strength of the file.

praise: Wood-oven vegetables and a slower, reservation-friendly sister to the Walrus oyster bar
A table that wants produce and fire more than a raw bar
complaints: Recent notes that some vegetable plates read less interesting than the house's reputation
Not a last-minute walk-in the way the oyster bar can be — a slower night, by design
rep.consistency: Wood oven + vegetables is the identity. Recent execution notes are thinner and mixed.

praise: Beacon Hill Filipino cooking people name specifically — sinigang, adobo, pancit — in a converted Craftsman
Infatuation's 9.4 is a critic score, not a Deep Dish rank; diners still call it a destination
complaints: Loud room; small portions at a high ticket on Tripadvisor
A local minority calls the 'elevated' framing overrated — do not treat critic scores as consensus
rep.consistency: Filipino identity is stable. Volume and value are the live complaints.

praise: Filipino-American counter tasting through Pacific Northwest producers is the culinary identity diners and critics named before the pause
Tiny room and personal service were the draw, not a backup of tables
complaints: Hard to book even when open; 12 seats
Temporarily closed as of August 3, 2026 for renovation — restaurant-owned pages say no reopen date is posted
rep.consistency: Prior praise is real; the live fact on this pass is the pause.

praise: Ballard family-style four-course pasta tasting — gnocchi/ragu when it lands, fried oysters as a bar path
Friendly service in an open room; the chef's menu is the default, not a secret
complaints: Pasta seasoning is the split: salty, lemon-heavy, or flavorless depending on the night
Pacing of the family-style barrage can feel like too much, too fast
rep.consistency: Format (family-style tasting, pasta) is stable. Execution of the pasta course is mixed.

praise: Dutch babies and European brunch are the dishes people wait for
Dinner is repeatedly described as the quieter path
complaints: Brunch reservations book out; walk-in waits of an hour-plus are normal
Peak brunch service can drop a drink or a candle request — the food is the reason people still wait
rep.consistency: Dutch baby / brunch identity is stable. The wait is the planning fact.
